names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Ηλιόδωρος από τη Μαγιδώ της Παμφιλίας», with the rank word and the place left off.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his line for 19 ноября ст. ст., «Илиодор Магидский (Памфилийский), мч.», with the rank word left off; the line itself gives the bare declined forename. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

death.note: Two sources one year apart and the interval is widened to hold both. saint.gr gave the 272 this folder held flat; days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line for 19 ноября ст. ст. with «(ок. 273)» and its life page «(+ ок. 273)». The same page puts him in the reign of Aurelian, «(270 - 275)», which holds both. Neither page gives a year of birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 ноября ст. ст. — «Мч. Илиодора (ок. 273).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (2 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ηλιόδωρος από τη Μαγιδώ της Παμφιλίας»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2909/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's five Heliodorus folders is this man: `heliodorus-the-martyr-20-august` is kept on 20 August, `heliodorus-companion-of-mark-the-shepherd` on 28 September, `heliodorus-of-africa` on 6 May, `heliodorus-of-altinum` on 3 July, and `heliodorus-golovanitsky` is a Russian of the nineteenth century. This one is placed by his own city, Magydos in Pamphylia, and by the governor Aetius under Aurelian. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
